player.name: OG Anunoby
player.physicalDescription: 6'7" forward with a powerful, broad-shouldered, linebacker-like build and long strong arms, very short cropped dark hair, light stubble beard, stoic expressionless face
player.archetype: The quiet stopper who decides the game in one moment

fusion.wardrobe: a rough undyed farmer's shawl of coarse wool draped over one shoulder and lifting in the leap, a plain leather cord belt over the blank shorts
fusion.accents: a long wooden ox-goad with an iron tip slung diagonally across his back on a leather strap; farm dust on his sneakers
fusion.aura: total silence - no celebration, no expression, just the job done. Barely mentioned, but decisive
fusion.background: the op-art concentric rings are drawn as the plowed furrows of a vast field curving around him; a pair of yoked oxen small in the distance at the edge of the field; a scattered field of tiny fallen feathered Philistine helmets lying empty in the furrows, hundreds of them (no people); two small empty winding roads disappearing into the hills; a small golden hourglass in a lower corner with only a few grains of sand left falling; two small gold crowns tucked into the paisley margins

figure.name: Shamgar
figure.attributeDescription: the farmer's ox-goad he used to strike down six hundred Philistines
figure.clothing: rough undyed wool tunic and shawl, leather cord belt
figure.physicalDescription: powerful farmer, sun-weathered, silent and steady
figure.archetype: The judge with one verse who saved Israel anyway

connection.thematic: Shamgar gets one verse in the entire Bible - and in it he saves Israel. OG barely says a word, then wins Game 4 with 1.2 seconds left.
connection.narrative: One verse. One tip-in. 'He also saved Israel.'
connection.relationship: The quiet ones who decide everything in a single moment

scripture.hebrew: וְאַחֲרָיו הָיָה שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בְּמַלְמַד הַבָּקָר וַיֹּשַׁע גַּם־הוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
scripture.english: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who smote of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox-goad; and he also saved Israel.

connection.receipt: Game-winning tip-in with 1.2 seconds left to win Game 4 of the 2026 Finals; career-best 20.1 playoff points per game; second NBA title (Toronto 2019)

interactions.description: OG Anunoby and Shamgar standing together as equals
